scope: Enemy-free navigation. The planner receives ONLY prepared 15x15 local categories/stairs, 16x16 coarse fractions/stairs/player-bin, and action masks. It never receives exact global XY, raw map, simulator state, scene/map IDs, teacher labels or route distances. Fixed 80x70 dimensions are public constants. History tracks repeated observations, own deterministic choices and coarse-bin visits; no assumed motion or hidden-map stitching.
